_doc: Twin copy of sim/realism/servo_params.json (servo_fit, 2026-11-15). Changed: first_order_K_per_tick (and time_constant_s) of every joint: pan 0.3024->0.42, lift 0.2518->0.378, elbow 0.2485->0.373, wrist_flex 0.288->0.45, wrist_roll 0.2944->0.42, gripper 0.2046->0.40. The A1 K values were fitted end to end (reading vs command), but the twin runs them in series with the PhysX PD lag (60 / 2 -> 33 ms) and the LeRobot clamp around the lagging reading, so the twin responded ~1.5x too slowly. Fitted by open-loop replay of 249 real windows (MolmoAct2 5.5k / 8k traces + cal2 teleop) in GraspEnv + play (sim/twin/servo_fit/, out/servo_fit/f_*). For the deployed controller also set PlayCfg(controller_delay=True) (1 tick on pan / wrist_flex / wrist_roll).
source: recorded teleop (duplo_teleop 517 eps old calibration; duplo_teleop_cal2 for comparison)
